site.title: ellipog
site.description: Manuals for the mods: how they work, how to configure them, and what the formats are.

/*sponsor: One affiliate arrangement, in the manifest because that is where the site's facts live — a link and a discount code written into a component would be a second place to keep in step. `code` is quoted verbatim on the page, and `url` carries the referral path.

sponsor.name: BisectHosting
sponsor./*badge: The small mark beside the host's name. `label` is what shows; `note` is the full phrase in the native tooltip, for a reader who wants to know what the mark means. The label is `Hosting partner`, and it was `Partner` alone until it was read beside the tagline it qualifies: `Minecraft server hosting` next to `PARTNER` says what the host does and that there is some arrangement, but not what the arrangement is about -- partner *of what*? `Hosting partner` carries both halves, so the chip states the relationship rather than leaving the tagline to imply it. Two alternatives were considered and dropped, and both are recorded here so they are not re-proposed: `Infrastructure` names a category this arrangement is not, and `Verified`/`Verified partner` claims a status the host does not confer -- BisectHosting's own material says `Partner Program` and `affiliate`, and never `verified`, so that word would be inventing a status, and a trust mark that overstates is worse than none. Change `label` to change the wording; nothing else needs touching.
sponsor./*logo: One mark, not two. It used to be a light and a dark SVG with CSS switching between them, but the glyph now takes its ink from `currentColor` and its knockouts from `var(--icon-ground)` -- so one file works on either ground and there is nothing left to switch. Generated by `bun run brand` from design/brand-source/, and committed like the mod icons.
sponsor./*logoSize: The mark declares a viewBox of 243.7 by 81.21 and no width or height of its own, so these are the numbers the layout reserves before it is parsed. They match the viewBox ratio, which is why the width is 123 and not a round number -- and why BrandMark derives the width from them rather than the other way round.

/*studio: Who engineers and maintains this site, and the one thing the colophon row at the foot of every page says. It is here rather than in the component for the same reason the sponsor is: the wording is a site fact, so changing it is one edit and the page cannot drift from it. `label` is quoted verbatim; `url` is the link AND the domain shown beside it, derived rather than typed twice, so the two cannot disagree.
